variants.name: Report
variants.look: Calm engineering-report page: misty white page, a full-bleed lagoon colour band, a flat white milestone diagram and one frosted-glass piece.
variants.tests: Baseline: the current VISUAL-SYSTEM-v1 look. Flat and calm, with the least colour.

variants.name: Luminous
variants.look: Colour-led: one silky aqua-to-lagoon gradient fills the background, with three floating frosted-glass discs on a white line.
variants.tests: More colour and softness: does a gradient field beat a calm page with one band?

variants.name: Studio 3D
variants.look: Product-photography still life: porcelain and frosted-glass plinths rising like steps on a pale aqua tabletop.
variants.tests: Dimensional, tactile objects versus flat graphics.

variants.name: Swiss type
variants.look: Type-led poster: a huge headline on off-white paper, one vertical brand-gradient bar and a thin minimal timeline.
variants.tests: Typography as the hero, with the least imagery.

variants.name: Module cards
variants.look: L1's winning Swiss poster, upgraded: a sharp display grotesk (Clash Display style) and a 2x2 grid of slightly raised module cards with pictograms; the Allergies card in the brand gradient.
variants.tests: Does the L1 winner, fixed for "font too basic" and "too flat", reach agency level?

variants.name: Interface
variants.look: A premium software-launch visual: a believable light-mode clinic app floating in perspective, the four modules as its sidebar; an editorial serif headline (Instrument Serif style).
variants.tests: Showing the software itself as the functional visual.

variants.name: Patient file
variants.look: An art-directed top-down photo: a white patient file with four coloured index tabs, one per module; the headline printed on the cover (Syne style).
variants.tests: A real, tactile object as the metaphor, with depth from real light.

variants.name: System map
variants.look: An isometric 3D diagram: four coloured module blocks with pictograms on a base slab that carries the stack; a wide rounded display face (Unbounded style).
variants.tests: An infographic that explains the system at a glance.
